messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "if giving through a nasogastric (ng) or gastrostomy tube, mix only with apple juice"
set: ["if giving through a nasogastric (ng) or gastrostomy tube, mix only with apple juice", "mix with apple juice", "mix with apple sauce", "this mixture can be given through a nasogastric (ng) feeding tube", "mix capsule with water or infant formula only", "mix with small amount of applesauce, apple juice, or water", "you may mix the concentrated solution with juice or a soft food such as applesauce", "oral granules should be mixed with applesauce or apple juice when taken by mouth", "mix with 4 ounces (half a cup) of water, ginger ale, lemon or lime soda, lemonade, or orange juice", "mix with infant formula", "fruit juice", "orange juice", "must mix powder with water", "mix granules with baby formula or breast milk", "mix powder form with at least 4 ounces (one-half cup) of cold water or fruit juice before taking", "mix the medicine with soft food"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
